title: Delete a specific Timeshift snapshot
summary: Remove an old or unnecessary system restore point to free up disk space.
prerequisites: You know the name of the snapshot to delete

steps.explain: Delete a specific snapshot by its name.

placeholders.name: SNAPSHOT_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the snapshot to delete, e.g., '2023-10-27_14-30-00'

warnings: Deleted snapshots cannot be recovered. Ensure you do not delete the most recent snapshot if you might need it soon.

rollback.explain: Deleted snapshots cannot be restored. There is no undo command for deletion.
